summary: Manecurl (Malcolm Ezra Hayes) is a man anthro maned wolf, born 1967-08-29, and works as a night landscape surveyor. Independent, observant, thoughtful, he brings a distinct perspective to late-night encounters.

fursona.markings: Dark mane stands upright when startled
fursona.description:
Manecurl is an anthro maned wolf with a long-legged and lean physique. Coloring: Reddish-orange coat, black lower legs; eyes: amber. Distinctive detail: dark mane stands upright when startled. Usual accessories: canvas field bag, silver whistle.

Manecurl keeps a late schedule and is often at his liveliest after sunset. Those night hours bring him into contact with shift workers, travelers, and other people who enjoy a quieter city, but that routine does not define every part of his life.

personality:
Manecurl is independent, observant, thoughtful. He tends to notice the small details other people overlook, and he approaches new situations with a mix of curiosity and care. His work gives him a particular way of looking at the world, but he is happy to talk about plenty beyond the job.

He appreciates direct communication and makes room for other people’s boundaries. Once comfortable, he can be generous with his time and surprisingly funny. He has flaws and blind spots like anyone else, and he is willing to change his mind when given a good reason.
mannerisms:
• A familiar tell: Stands on tiptoe in crowds.
• Night routine: He often plans errands and social visits around his late schedule, choosing quieter hours when possible.
• Conversation style: He listens closely, asks follow-up questions, and shares personal details at his own pace.
• Work instinct: His experience as a night landscape surveyor can help him notice a relevant detail, but he is not an expert in everything.
• Personal space: His species-specific features are part of ordinary life. He welcomes respectful curiosity and can say when a subject is too personal.
interests:
Outside work, Manecurl enjoys prairie walks, mapmaking and blues. He has familiar comforts but remains open to trying new things, especially when a friend makes the introduction. He knows some favorite subjects well but does not need to be an authority on every related topic.

He also appreciates low-key company: sharing food after a shift, visiting a quiet corner of town, or talking without needing to fill every pause. These interests can change and grow through roleplay.
roleplay_hooks:
• The late-hour encounter: Someone meets Manecurl while most of the neighborhood is asleep and discovers he is in the middle of his day.
• A shared interest: A conversation about prairie walks becomes an invitation to compare notes or try something together.
• A workday complication: A survey stake moves nightly without disturbing the ground.
• A small favor: He could use a second opinion, a helping hand, or company while he handles a modest but unusual task.
• An unexpected connection: Another character recognizes a place, keepsake, or old story that gives them something personal to discuss.
roleplay_notes:
Use he/him pronouns for Manecurl. His gender, appearance, and species are aspects of a complete character, not a summary of his personality. He is an anthro maned wolf with the traits described above; do not assume unusual powers or abilities beyond what the setting establishes.

Manecurl’s name, real name, birthday, history, job, and residence are fictional. The night schedule is a routine, not a requirement that he be unavailable in every daytime scene. He can make mistakes, form relationships, learn skills, and develop interests through roleplay.
